value.rationale: The natural full general-position simplicial complexes of cycles first develop integral H2 at n=9, and among even cycles at n=12. The complete first-onset range is established including torsion-freeness, while the rank-three first example has a nontrivial order-three symmetry action and rational symmetry quotient retaining exactly one H2 class. Cutoffs are mathematically motivated first-occurrence boundaries, not a convenience slice.
